contents.Text: The headings below match the headings in the image above.

This is where the download arguments are stored. Each entry is a [[[strong:profile]]], made up of a comment (its name) and its args. See the [[[button:Yt-dlp page][../../../Downloader/Playlist Editor/YT_dlp_args]]] for more information on args.
In the images above:
[[[underline:Soft Purple]]] ≈ Selected profile
[[[underline:Soft Yellow]]] ≈ Edit comments and Edit args
[[[underline:Dark Blue]]] ≈ Other profiles
[[[underline:Light Green]]] ≈ Add
[[[strong:Left click]]] a profile to select it for editing.
[[[strong:Right click]]] to deselect it.
•[[[strong:Comments:]]] The name of the profile.
•[[[strong:Args:]]] The arguments for the profile. Each line is a separate argument, applied in order from top to bottom.
•[[[strong:Save:]]] Saves your changes and finalises the edit.
•[[[strong:Close:]]] Cancels the edit without saving.
•[[[strong:Remove:]]] Permanently removes the entire profile.
[[[strong:Built-in profiles]]]
These are the default profiles provided with the program. The comment is [[[strong:locked]]] (greyed out), so they cannot be renamed or removed, but their args can still be edited.

[[[warning:Note:]]] When a new release updates the built-in profiles, their args are overwritten with the new defaults. This lets updates push changes to every user. To keep your own changes, add a new profile instead (see [[[strong:Add]]] below).
[[[strong:Custom profiles]]]
These are profiles you have added yourself. You can edit the comment and the args freely, and they are [[[strong:never]]] changed by updates.
These are the remaining profiles. The built-in profiles are listed first, and any custom profiles you add are [[[strong:appended after them]]]. Select them in the same way as the selected profile.
Adds a new custom profile. [[[strong:Add]]] shares its contents with the edit section, so you can quickly duplicate an existing profile:
•Select the profile you want to duplicate.
•Click [[[strong:Add]]] to open the add menu.
•Edit the [[[strong:comment]]] and the [[[strong:args]]].
•Click [[[strong:Save]]] to finalise.
•Click [[[strong:Close]]] to cancel.
The new profile is added to the end of the list, after the built-in profiles and any existing custom profiles.
[[[warning:Note:]]] The comment and the args must both be filled in. If either is empty, a notification is shown and the profile is not added.
[[[strong:Tip:]]] Duplicating a built-in profile is the way to keep your own changes to it, as custom profiles are never overwritten by updates.

TextCustom.content: These actions affect the downloader and search caches.

contents.Text: •[[[strong:Manually Regenerate Search Cache:]]] Triggers a regeneration of the search cache without clearing it.
This is useful if you have added new files and want them included in the search cache straight away.

TextCustom.content: [[[warning:Note:]]] This already happens automatically via the file watcher. The button is only here in case you are impatient.

contents.Text: •[[[strong:Clear Regenerate Search Cache:]]] Clears the search cache used by the new search implementation.

TextCustom.content: This forces all searches to be regenerated.

contents.Text: •[[[strong:Clear Audio Fingerprint Cache:]]] Clears the audio fingerprint cache.

TextCustom.content: This removes all audio fingerprints from the search database.

contents.Text: •[[[strong:Graveyard Cache:]]] Where dead or broken links are stored so that they are never used again.

TextCustom.content: [[[warning:Note:]]] If you clear [[[strong:Graveyard Cache]]], expect a large number of URLs to be attempted again.

contents.Text: •[[[strong:Graveyard Temp:]]] Holds links that have failed, but not often enough to be merged into [[[strong:Graveyard Cache]]].
Both buttons clear their respective caches, forcing failed or potentially failed URLs to be downloaded again.

TextCustom.content: [[[warning:Note:]]] You probably don't want to do this unless you tried to download while offline. Downloading offline makes every download fail, so false positives are added to these caches.

contents.Text: •[[[strong:Clear Download Cache:]]] Clears all previously downloaded URLs, effectively resetting the downloader.

TextCustom.content: [[[warning:Note:]]] This forces all successful URLs to be downloaded again. Use it only if a complete reset is necessary.

contents.Text: •[[[strong:Force Yt-dlp and Deno Update:]]] Forces Yt-dlp and Deno to update immediately.
This is done automatically once a week, but you can use this button to update straight away if an emergency update is pushed to Yt-dlp.

TextCustom.content: [[[strong:Tip:]]] If a download fails, press this to update and try again. It may fix the issue.

contents.Text: •[[[strong:Delete Wiki:]]] Deletes the wiki folder and all of its contents. This is useful if you no longer want the wiki installed.
These are actions for mass deletion.
[[[warning:Note:]]] These actions are final and cannot be reversed.
•[[[strong:Prune History for Dead Searches:]]] Searches each entry in [[[strong:History]]] and removes it if the search returns nothing.
•[[[strong:Clear History:]]] Fully removes everything from [[[strong:History]]].
